description: Discord bot framework for V, inspired by Seyfert. Commands, options, components, modals and events are plain V structs with attributes that veyfert reads at compile time, so options are typed fields and mistakes fail to build. It includes a sharded gateway with resuming and zlib or zstd compression, REST with rate limits and generated endpoints, an in-memory cache with shorters, Components v2, prefix commands, languages, plugins, interactions over HTTP and a testing kit.
name: MARCROCK22.veyfert
